clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with a role authorizing vocabulary management
I navigate to the Vocabulary Management screen in the UI

acs.label: AC1
acs.heading: AC1 – Validation Trigger on File Upload

clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with vocabulary management permissions
I upload a vocabulary file in the UI
the system automatically performs syntax and structure validation on the uploaded file

acs.label: AC2
acs.heading: AC2 – Validation Trigger on Submit (Creation)

clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with vocabulary management permissions
I submit a new vocabulary via the UI
the system performs syntax and structure validation as part of the submission flow

acs.label: AC3
acs.heading: AC3 – Validation Trigger on Submit (Version Update)

clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with vocabulary management permissions
I submit a new version of an existing vocabulary
the system performs syntax and structure validation as part of the version submission flow

acs.label: AC4
acs.heading: AC4 – Successful Validation

clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with vocabulary management permissions
the uploaded or submitted vocabulary file contains no syntax or structure errors
validation is completed
the system:

acs.label: AC5

clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with vocabulary management permissions
the uploaded or submitted vocabulary file contains syntax errors
validation is performed
the system:

acs.label: AC6
acs.heading: AC6 – Structure Errors Detected

the uploaded or submitted vocabulary file violates required structure rules
validation is performed
the system:

clauses.text: I am authenticated as a Governance Authority with vocabulary management permissions
validation errors have been detected

stories.title: Validate vocabulary syntax via API

user_story.i want: the API to validate vocabulary syntax when I submit a vocabulary creation or new version creation request
user_story.so that: syntactically invalid vocabularies are rejected before semantic validation and version creation continue

acs.label: AC1
acs.heading: Positive Scenario – Submitted vocabulary passes validation

clauses.text: I am authenticated and authorised with the Vocabulary Management role
I submit a vocabulary creation or new version creation request via the API
the submitted vocabulary has valid syntax
the API processes the request
the API validates the vocabulary syntax
the request passes the syntax validation step
the request is allowed to proceed to semantic validation
no syntax validation errors are returned
the API response or processing state indicates that syntax validation has passed

acs.label: AC2
acs.heading: Negative Scenario – Submitted vocabulary contains syntax errors

clauses.text: I am authenticated and authorised with the Vocabulary Management role
I submit a vocabulary creation or new version creation request via the API
the submitted vocabulary has invalid syntax
the API processes the request
the API validates the vocabulary syntax
the request is rejected at the syntax validation step
semantic validation is not performed
the vocabulary is not created as an ACTIVE vocabulary
no new ACTIVE version is created
no previous versions are deprecated
the API returns a structured error response
the error response includes a list of syntax validation errors with precise locations and descriptions

other_text: This story covers syntax validation only.
Semantic validation is covered in a separate story.

stories.title: Validate vocabulary semantics via UI
stories.status: DevTeam PBI is ready for Implementation check

user_story.i want: Simpl-Open to perform semantic validation automatically when I submit a vocabulary or a new vocabulary version via the UI
user_story.so that: I can ensure terms are unique, consistent, and logically coherent

acs.label: AC1
acs.heading: AC1 – Semantic validation triggered after syntax validation

clauses.text: a vocabulary or vocabulary version has passed syntax validation
the vocabulary version is submitted via the UI
Simpl-Open performs semantic validation

acs.label: AC2
acs.heading: AC2 – Successful semantic validation

clauses.text: a vocabulary version is semantically valid
Simpl-Open completes semantic validation
the validation result is successful

acs.label: AC3
acs.heading: AC3 – Semantic validation failure reporting

clauses.text: a vocabulary version contains semantic issues
Simpl-Open completes semantic validation
Simpl-Open provides a structured report detailing semantic errors

stories.title: Validate vocabulary semantics via API
stories.status: DevTeam PBI is ready for Implementation check

user_story.i want: semantic validation to be performed when I submit a vocabulary creation or new version request via the API
user_story.so that: I can integrate semantic checks into automated vocabulary pipelines without a separate validation endpoint

acs.label: AC1
acs.heading: Positive Scenario – Semantic validation passes

clauses.text: I am an authenticated Governance Authority user
I have a role allowing vocabulary management
the vocabulary has correct semantics
I submit a vocabulary creation or new version creation request via the API
the submitted vocabulary passes syntax validation
semantic validation is performed
the vocabulary or vocabulary version is created

acs.label: AC2
acs.heading: Negative Scenario – Semantic validation fails

clauses.text: I am an authenticated Governance Authority user
I have a role allowing vocabulary management
the vocabulary contains semantic issues
I submit a vocabulary creation or new version creation request via the API
the submitted vocabulary passes syntax validation
semantic validation is performed
a structured list of semantic errors or warnings is returned
the vocabulary or vocabulary version is not created
doing semantic validation don't fail on first issue - perform a full semantic validation and return all semantic errors

other_text: - we can only validate against self managed vocabularies as it wouldn't be safe to fetch external vocabularies
- we issue warnings for external vocabularies that cannot be resolved

stories.title: Automatic check for deprecated vocabularies during new version creation in UI
stories.status: DevTeam PBI is ready for Implementation check

user_story.i want: Simpl-Open to automatically check the status of vocabulary versions I reuse when creating a new version
user_story.so that: I avoid reusing deprecated versions

clauses.text: I am authenticated and authorised as a Governance Authority user with vocabulary management admin rights
I am creating a new vocabulary version
I reference one or more existing vocabulary versions
all referenced vocabulary versions have status _ACTIVE_
I submit the new vocabulary version for creation
Simpl-Open validates the status of each referenced vocabulary version
the validation passes
the new vocabulary version creation process can continue
no deprecated-version warning or error is returned
I am authenticated and authorised as a Governance Authority user with vocabulary management admin rights
I am creating a new vocabulary version
I reference one or more existing vocabulary versions
at least one referenced vocabulary version has status _DEPRECATED_
I submit the new vocabulary version for creation
Simpl-Open validates the status of each referenced vocabulary version
the validation fails for each referenced version with status _DEPRECATED_
the new vocabulary version is not created
no existing vocabulary versions are changed
the API/UI returns a clear validation error identifying each deprecated vocabulary version
the error message recommends using the latest _ACTIVE_ version where available
I am authenticated and authorised as a Governance Authority user with vocabulary management admin rights
I am creating a new vocabulary version
I reference a vocabulary version that does not exist
I submit the new vocabulary version for creation
Simpl-Open validates the referenced vocabulary version
the validation fails
the new vocabulary version is not created
the API/UI returns a clear validation error identifying the missing vocabulary version

acs.label: AC4

clauses.text: I am authenticated and authorised as a Governance Authority user with vocabulary management admin rights
I am creating a new vocabulary version in the Vocabulary Management UI
I select or reference a vocabulary version with status _DEPRECATED_
Simpl-Open displays a clear warning that the selected version is deprecated
the warning identifies the deprecated vocabulary version
the warning recommends selecting the latest _ACTIVE_ version where available

other_text: * this is only for INTERNAL vocabularies (managed by vocabulary management), a vocabulary may reference external vocabularies but we cannot enforce their versioning and deprecation status
* so we check vocabularies against internally created vocabularies

the new version is successfully created
